  SELECT DATE '2024-01-01' AS q1_start, DATE '2024-03-31' AS q1_end

  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.account_id) AS total_customers
  FROM subscriptions s, q1_start q

)

input.query:
WITH q1_period AS (
  SELECT DATE '2024-01-01' AS period_start, DATE '2024-03-31' AS period_end
),
accounts_at_risk AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT s.account_id, p.tier
  FROM subscriptions s
  JOIN plans p ON s.plan_id = p.plan_id
  WHERE s.start_date <= (SELECT period_end FROM q1_period)
    AND (s.end_date IS NULL OR s.end_date >= (SELECT period_start FROM q1_period))
    AND s.mrr > 0
),
tier_totals AS (
  SELECT tier, COUNT(DISTINCT account_id) AS total
  FROM accounts_at_risk
  GROUP BY tier
),
churned_by_tier AS (
  SELECT p.tier, COUNT(DISTINCT s.account_id) AS churned
  FROM subscriptions s
  JOIN plans p ON s.plan_id = p.plan_id
  WHERE s.status = 'churned'
    AND s.end_date BETWEEN (SELECT period_start FROM q1_period) AND (SELECT period_end FROM q1_period)
    AND s.mrr > 0
  GROUP BY p.tier
)
SELECT 
  t.tier,
  t.total AS customers_at_risk,
  COALESCE(c.churned, 0) AS churned,
  ROUND(COALESCE(c.churned, 0) * 100.0 / t.total, 2) AS churn_rate_pct

WITH churned_accounts AS (

    s.status,
    s.start_date,
    s.end_date,
    s.mrr,
    p.plan_name,
    p.tier,
    p.monthly_price,
    LAG(p.plan_name) OVER (PARTITION BY s.account_id ORDER BY s.start_date) AS prev_plan,
    LAG(p.tier) OVER (PARTITION BY s.account_id ORDER BY s.start_date) AS prev_tier,
    LAG(s.mrr) OVER (PARTITION BY s.account_id ORDER BY s.start_date) AS prev_mrr,
    LEAD(p.plan_name) OVER (PARTITION BY s.account_id ORDER BY s.start_date) AS next_plan,

  FROM subscriptions s

),

  SELECT 
    pc.*,
    c.churn_date,
    pc.start_date AS change_date,
    CASE 
      WHEN pc.prev_plan IS NOT NULL AND pc.plan_name != pc.prev_plan THEN 'Plan Changed'
      WHEN pc.prev_plan IS NULL THEN 'Initial Plan'
      ELSE 'No Change'
    END AS change_type,
    CASE 
      WHEN pc.tier != pc.prev_tier AND pc.prev_tier IS NOT NULL THEN 
        CASE 
          WHEN pc.tier > pc.prev_tier THEN 'Upgrade'
          WHEN pc.tier < pc.prev_tier THEN 'Downgrade'
        END
      ELSE NULL
    END AS tier_change_direction
  FROM plan_changes pc
  JOIN churned_accounts c ON pc.account_id = c.account_id
)
SELECT 
  change_type,
  tier_change_direction,
  COUNT(*) AS num_changes,
  COUNT(DISTINCT account_id) AS num_accounts,
  AVG(EXTRACT(DAY FROM churn_date - change_date))::numeric(10,1) AS avg_days_before_churn,

WITH quarterly_data AS (

  FROM subscriptions

q1_summary AS (
  SELECT 
    year,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'churned') AS churned,
    COUNT(*) AS total_subscriptions,
    ROUND(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'churned')::NUMERIC / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) * 100, 2) AS churn_rate
  FROM quarterly_data

)
SELECT 
  year AS year,

  churn_rate,

1. Accounts with declining feature usage
2. Accounts with late payments
3. Accounts with reduced seats

input.query:
WITH account_metrics AS (
    SELECT 
        a.account_id,
        a.account_name,
        a.segment,
        a.industry,
        COALESCE(inv.late_payment_count, 0) AS late_payment_count,
        COALESCE(inv.overdue_amount, 0) AS overdue_amount,
        COALESCE(fu.declining_usage_pct, 0) AS usage_decline_pct,
        COALESCE(u.inactive_user_count, 0) AS inactive_users,
        COALESCE(u.total_users, 1) AS total_users,
        COALESCE(sub.seat_change, 0) AS seat_change
    FROM accounts a
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT account_id, 
               COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'late' OR status = 'overdue') AS late_payment_count,
               SUM(total_amount) FILTER (WHERE status = 'late' OR status = 'overdue') AS overdue_amount
        FROM invoices
        GROUP BY account_id
    ) inv ON a.account_id = inv.account_id
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT fu.account_id,
               CASE 
                   WHEN SUM(event_count) OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY usage_date ROWS BETWEEN 30 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) = 0 THEN 100
                   ELSE 100 - (AVG(event_count) OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY usage_date ROWS BETWEEN 7 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) * 100 / 
                       NULLIF(AVG(event_count) OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY usage_date ROWS BETWEEN 30 PRECEDING AND 8 PRECEDING), 0))
               END AS declining_usage_pct
        FROM feature_usage fu
    ) fu ON a.account_id = fu.account_id
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT account_id,
               COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_active = false) AS inactive_user_count,
               COUNT(*) AS total_users
        FROM users
        GROUP BY account_id
    ) u ON a.account_id = u.account_id
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT account_id, SUM(seats) as seat_change
        FROM subscriptions
        GROUP BY account_id
    ) sub ON a.account_id = sub.account_id
)
SELECT 
    account_id,
    account_name,
    segment,
    industry,
    late_payment_count,
    ROUND(overdue_amount::numeric, 2) AS overdue_amount,
    ROUND(usage_decline_pct::numeric, 1) AS usage_decline_pct,
    inactive_users,
    total_users,
    seat_change,
    (late_payment_count * 30 + overdue_amount / 100 + usage_decline_pct + inactive_users * 10 + ABS(seat_change) * 5)::integer AS churn_risk_score
FROM account_metrics
WHERE late_payment_count > 0 OR usage_decline_pct > 0 OR inactive_users > 0 OR seat_change < 0
ORDER BY churn_risk_score DESC, late_payment_count DESC, usage_decline_pct DESC
LIMIT 10
